B1216/26 NOTAMR B1215/26  Q) MMFR/QRDCA/IV/BO/W/000/999/  A) MMFR  B) 2606101940  C) 2609151500  E) THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA HAS ISSUED AN ADVISORY     REGARDING A POTENTIALLY HAZARDOUS SITUATION WITHIN THE MAZATLAN     OCEANIC (MMFO), MEXICO (MMFR), CENTRAL AMERICA (MHTG),     BOGOTA(SKED),GUAYAQUIL (SEFG), AND PANAMA (MPZL) FLIGHT INFORMATION     REGIONS.          IT IS RECOMMENDED THAT OPERATORS EXERCISE CAUTION WHILE OPERATING IN     THE AREAS OVER THE PACIFIC OCEAN AND THE GULF OF CALIFORNIA WITHIN     THESE FLIGHT INFORMATION REGIONS (FIR) DUE TO MILITARY ACTIVITIES AND     GNSS INTERFERENCE. THERE IS A POTENTIAL RISK TO AIRCRAFT AT ALL     ALTITUDES, INCLUDING OVERFLIGHTS AND THE ARRIVAL AND DEPARTURE PHASES     OF FLIGHT.          AIR NAVIGATION AND AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL SERVICES MAINTAIN THEIR     SURVEILLANCE SYSTEMS (SURVEILLANCE RADAR) AND CONVENTIONAL RADIO     NAVIGATION AIDS (VOR/DME) NATIONWIDE FULLY OPERATIONAL, AS THESE ARE     NOT VULNERABLE TO GNSS INTERFERENCE.  F) SFC  G) UNL
